properties.name: Casa Azul Beach Villa

steps: Reach the blue gate marked Casa Azul.
Take the Villa A key and return the lockbox cover.
Keep one ID proof ready for host verification.
Switch off AC units, geysers and kitchen appliances.
Leave used towels in the bathroom basket.
Lock the main door and place the key back in the lockbox.
Send a checkout message to the host before leaving.

parking.summary: One reserved car parking spot is available inside the blue gate. Extra two-wheelers can be parked near the security cabin.

facilities: Private pool open from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM
Fully equipped kitchen with induction, microwave and fridge
Power backup for lights, fans and Wi-Fi
Smart TV with guest streaming access
Daily housekeeping between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM

steps: Tell security you are checking in to Flat 402.
Use lift B and collect the smart lock code from the host message.
Keep noise low after 10:00 PM as this is a residential building.
Clear personal food items from the refrigerator.
Place the access card on the dining table.
Close all windows and lock the balcony door.
Message the host once you exit the apartment.

parking.summary: Basement parking slot B-17 is reserved for your stay. Share your vehicle number with security on arrival.
